snippet.title: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4084400?utm_source=yt
📣 Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/c9BAb7mBAT

Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix is a sequel (technically prequel) to the cult hit Astral Throne. Dubbed “the Roguelike Fire Emblem”, Astral Throne merged the grid-based combat of classic Strategy RPGs like Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics with the buildcrafting and replayability of modern Roguelikes like FTL and Slay the Spire.

Astral Throne II builds upon its predecessor and fully realizes its potential. 

Written by the multi-award-winning fantasy novelist Shami Stovall (Frith Chronicles, Chronos Chronicles), Astral Throne delivers a sprawling, character-driven, continent-wide conspiracy story. With long-term story progression that persists between runs, players will advance an epic quest and build bonds between characters through a relationship system- one that offers gameplay rewards as well as story.

Astral Throne II also boasts an attractive art style: a beautiful blend of pixel art 2D and 3D with modern lighting and post-processing effects, reminiscent of the HD-2D graphical styling of games like Octopath Traveler and Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake.

It’s a game we can’t believe doesn’t exist yet, and we can’t wait to deliver it to both Roguelite and Strategy RPG fans alike.
